scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d postgres valkey kafka
scripts.dev:build-remotes: pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/trading-mfe build && pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/portfolio-mfe build && pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/orders-mfe build && pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/simulator-mfe build
scripts.dev:serve: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "t:watch,p:watch,o:watch,s:watch,t:preview,p:preview,o:preview,s:preview,shell" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/trading-mfe build:watch" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/portfolio-mfe build:watch" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/orders-mfe build:watch" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/simulator-mfe build:watch" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/trading-mfe preview" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/portfolio-mfe preview" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/orders-mfe preview" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/simulator-mfe preview" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/trader-ui dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "gateway,market,order,risk,exec,portfolio,notif" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,green,yellow,red,magenta,white" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/api-gateway start:dev" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/market-data-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/order-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/risk-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/execution-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/portfolio-service start:dev" "pnpm --filter @pulsedesk/notification-service start:dev"
